verdict.rationale: The evidence shows run data is kept on the phone and that users can choose any OpenAI-compatible model endpoint, local or cloud. But choosing an inference endpoint decides where data is sent for processing, not where it is stored. No region or residency selection for stored data is documented, so the endpoint choice is only an adjacent control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
